about_the_game:
Rage Room Catharsis: The Most Enjoyable Way to Release Stress

Ever felt tense at the end of a long day? Rage Room Catharsis is designed precisely for those moments!

Psychological research shows that physical expression in a safe and controlled environment can lower stress levels, support mental balance, and promote emotional relief. The ancient practice of catharsis now meets the immersive power of virtual reality.

How Does It Work?
While playing, your body naturally:
• Reduces stress hormone levels
• Releases endorphins (your “happy hormones”)
• Relieves muscle tension
• Calms your mind

So, when you put on your VR headset, you’re not just playing—you’re rebalancing your nervous system.

Why Rage Room Catharsis?

🧨 Smash the Unsmasheable
Shatter expensive vases, giant TVs, and office chairs—do the impossible in VR, safely and guilt-free.

🔨 Choose Your Weapon
Sledgehammer, baseball bat, handgun, laser sword—whatever fits your stress relief style.

⚡ Slow Motion Mode
Feel every hit in cinematic slow motion. Watch debris fly and tension melt away.

🌍 Diverse Environments
Not just a room! Explore metro stations, space bases, industrial labs, and more to match your mood.

🎮 Two Gameplay Modes

🕒 Challenge Mode
Destroy specified targets within a time limit. Fast-paced gameplay that tests your focus and precision.

🌀 Free Mode
No rules. No time pressure. Just break, smash, and release as you wish—perfect for emotional catharsis and deep relaxation.

The Result?
By the end of the session, you won’t just have broken objects—you’ll have broken free.
🎧 Let Rage Room Catharsis absorb your stress in VR, and return to the real world calmer, lighter, and renewed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3,20GHz / AMD Phenom II X4 955 3,2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / AMD 6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: All
  • VR Support: Oculus OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / AMD 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: All
  • VR Support: Oculus OpenXR

short_description: No rules, no limits—just pure destruction! Use a sledgehammer, baseball bat, pistol, and more to release your stress. Take on Challenge Mode to race against time or go all out in Free Roam Mode!
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, German, Arabic, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish*, Czech
*languages with full audio support
